l-m-m1-b04-29.material: Kunxantathu u-ABC onu-AB=AC no-∠A=50°, u-∠B wathola kanjena. ① Njengoba AB=AC, ∠B=∠C ② Isamba sezingeli zangaphakathi singu-180° ③ ∠B+∠C=180°−50°=130° ④ ∠B=130°
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: Uma AB=AC, izingeli zesisekelo u-∠B no-∠C ziyalingana, ngakho kuyiso.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.r.b: Kuyiso ukuthi isamba sezingeli zangaphakathi zikanxantathu singu-180°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.explain: U-∠B no-∠C bayalingana futhi isamba sabo singu-130°, ngakho ∠B=130°÷2=65°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Isamba sika-∠B no-∠C singu-130°, kodwa u-∠B yedwa wathiwa ungu-130°, ngakho ④ iphutha. Ukuhlukanisa ngo-2 kunika u-65°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: ∠B=∠C, ngakho u-130° kufanele wahlukaniswe kabili, yingakho ∠B=65° kuyiso.

l-m-m1-b03-37.s.s2.model.0: I-1℃ ingu-2℃ noma ngaphansi futhi ngu-−5℃ noma ngaphezulu, futhi ingu-0℃ noma ngaphezulu futhi ingu-6℃ noma ngaphansi, ngakho ihlangabezana nemibandela yomibili.
